purpose: Account of Alexey reading and explaining Karpathy's autoresearch repository

required_facts.fact: Andrej Karpathy created the autoresearch project.
The project automates repeated model experiments.
prepare.py contains fixed preparation and evaluation components.
train.py contains editable model and training code.
program.md gives the agent natural-language instructions.
The system establishes a baseline on a new branch.
Improved commits are kept and worse or unchanged runs are reset.
Experiments use a fixed time budget and validation bits per byte.
Karpathy reported 110 successful changes in about twelve hours.
Autosearcher and AutoVoiceEvals apply related patterns.

author_attribution: Alexey is a reader of Karpathy's repository, not its creator.
